title: Reconditioning Estimate in a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Redemption
content:
An involuntarily recovered vehicle financed under a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract carries in its redemption figure the estimated cost of preparing it for the sale the redemption takes the place of, an expense of disposition the redemption must cover. The estimate follows the vehicle's age: the whole years from January 1 of the model year to the quote date, a year counted only once it is complete.

| Recovery and vehicle age | Reconditioning estimate |
|---|---|
| Involuntary recovery, more than 5 years old (the newer-model years) | $350.00, the older-model estimate |
| Involuntary recovery, no more than 5 years old | $200.00, the newer-model estimate |
| Voluntary surrender, any age | none |

**Points of judgement (hypothetical model years)**

- A model year five years before the year of the quote date: age 5, not more than 5, so $200.00 on an involuntary recovery.
- A model year six years before, quote on 1 January: the sixth year is complete that day, age 6, so $350.00.
- A voluntary surrender of the same vehicle carries no estimate at all.
